full.description: This image is a micrograph of a tissue sample, likely a tumor or lesion, stained with a histological stain (such as H&E). It shows loosely arranged cells embedded within myxoid or pale-staining extracellular matrices. The morphology includes areas with tumor cells that may resemble chondroblasts or stromal elements within a myxoid background. The overall appearance is consistent with a myxoid neoplasm or tumor with extensive myxoid change, such as angiomyofibroblastoma or a similar soft tissue lesion.

random.description: This is a micrograph showing a tissue section stained with a special stain, likely periodic acid-Schiff (PAS). The image displays renal tissue, specifically showing cortical tubules. The renal tubular structures demonstrate findings consistent with glycogen accumulation or storage. The overall appearance is characteristic of glycogen nephrosis (Armanni-Ebstein change).
